name: Helix's beam
doc: Helix's beam (Helix's enemy attack): the master - its sound, layouts at two points of the caster and their midpoint, two curving beams to the target then two straight ones fading, the screen flash, a white tile, particles and the impact layout at the target; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag063_helix_attack.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Master
parts.doc: Its sound, the layouts at the caster's points, the two beams, the flash, the particles and the impact at the target, the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage of the first target at this tick

params.label: Impact offset
params.doc: The impact this far from the target towards the caster
